title: Volunteer Orientation
body: Want to volunteer? Come to our orientation to give you ideas how you can fit it in doing things you enjoy. There's plenty!

title: Adult Workday
body: Come on out for the next adult workday, which will be in October. As always, we will have food and drink. Stay tuned for dates and stay hydrated!

title: Nursery Team
role: We always have openings in the...
body: The crew behind the green stuff — potting, propagating, watering, and nursing cuttings into sellable plants. We sort and pot donated specimens, keep the benches tidy, and run the plant sales that help fund the park. Good music, good dirt, good company.

title: Franky and Randy
role: Bright Futures High School Program, Wednesdays
body: Franky & Randy lead a hands-on volunteer program that gives Bright Futures High School students a meaningful way to put in their three hours a week—digging in the dirt, clearing park debris, planting new additions, pitching in on office work, setting up for park events, and tackling the zillion odd chores that keep a botanical park running.
